en.title: RFQ physics guide · from voltage to bunch width
en.lead: Start with the voltage convention, then follow the field, motion and observables. The calculations below describe ideal or reduced models; each tab states its assumptions.
en.roles_title: 1 · What does each RFQ stage do?
roles: Ion guide
Alternating transverse focusing transports ions along an open axis.
Aperture acceptance and transmitted fraction for a specified input beam.
Cooler
RF confinement and collisions with a buffer gas reduce the phase-space spread.
Energy spread, emittance, cooling time and surviving fraction.
Mass filter
RF plus differential DC selects a range of mass-to-charge ratios.
Transmission versus mass-to-charge, peak width and resolving power.
Buncher
An axial DC well stores ions; a switched exit potential releases a pulse.
Bunch charge, pulse width, time–energy correlation and repetition rate.
en.roles_note: A stable Mathieu point establishes transverse stability for the ideal field. It does not determine cooling performance, a transmitted fraction, or mass resolving power.
en.field_title: 2 · Define the electrodes before calculating a and q
en.field_text: Take the x rod pair at +(U − V cos Ωt) and the y pair at −(U − V cos Ωt), relative to a shared common-mode potential. Here V is the RF peak amplitude of one rod, Q = ze is the ion charge, Ω = 2πfRF, and r₀ is the inscribed radius.
en.field_voltage: For balanced rods: 150 V rod peak = 300 V rod peak-to-peak = 300 V differential peak = 600 V differential peak-to-peak. A common platform offset is a different quantity and does not belong in V.
en.field_derivation: From E = −∇Φ and m ẍ = QEx, substitute τ = Ωt/2. The factor Ω²/4 in the time derivative gives the coefficients below. The two radial axes have opposite a and q signs.
en.field_stability: Both radial axes must remain bounded. For a = 0 the first ideal stability region extends to |q| ≈ 0.908; the q = 0 point provides no RF confinement. Higher stability bands need the full characteristic-value calculation.
en.average_title: 3 · Separate slow secular motion from micromotion
en.average_text: For a slowly varying RF field and small |q|, average the fast micromotion to obtain a pseudopotential energy W. For an ideal quadrupole its radial dependence is quadratic. D below is the RF-only depth at r = r₀; differential DC tilts the effective curvature along the two axes.
en.average_units: D is an energy: QVq/4 in joules, or zVq/4 in eV when V is in volts. Near a stability boundary, use the Mathieu exponent β and fsec = βfRF/2 instead of the small-q approximation.
en.example_inputs: U = 0 V; V = 150 V rod peak; fRF = 0.700 MHz; r₀ = 10.0 mm.
en.example_outputs: q = 0.2992656; D = 11.22246 eV; fsec ≈ 74.0644 kHz (small-q estimate). These values are analytically calculated, not measured.
en.sensitivity: Sensitivity: doubling RF amplitude doubles q; doubling frequency or aperture radius divides q by four. At U = 0, fsec scales as V/(mfRF r₀²) for fixed charge. Rod size and finite electrode length require a field model before their effect can be inferred.
en.gas_title: 4 · Relate pressure to collisions, then to cooling
en.gas_text: Use local gas pressure and temperature to obtain number density. The collision frequency also needs a cross section and relative velocity. The gas tab uses a constant-rate relaxation approximation; increasing pressure alone is not a validated transmission optimization.
en.gas_limits: At 300 K the three-dimensional thermal mean kinetic energy is 3kBT/2 ≈ 0.03878 eV. RF heating, gas flow, mass-dependent collision kinematics, charge exchange, space charge and aperture losses can change the actual result. A vacuum reading far from the rods may not equal the local cooling-gas pressure.
en.bunch_title: 5 · Carry time–energy covariance through a drift
en.bunch_text: After acceleration to a mean kinetic energy E, a field-free drift of length L takes td = L√(m/2E). Linearize around the mean: later launch time and higher energy can compensate because g = ∂td/∂E is negative. The output variance must include the covariance term.
en.bunch_units: Use consistent units: if g is in ns/eV, σt must be in ns and σE in eV. For a Gaussian pulse, FWHM = 2√(2 ln 2)σ ≈ 2.35482σ. A Gaussian-equivalent width from a local event table is not a fitted width for a non-Gaussian peak.
en.bunch_limits: An RFQ exit bunch width and an MR-TOF detector peak width are different observables. Switching fields, timing jitter and aberrations need a trajectory calculation; later optics can focus or broaden a correlated bunch.
en.sources_text: Use the Lab tabs for reproducible analytical and numerical exploration. Finite electrodes, stochastic cooling, extraction fields and experimentally verified transmission require additional field/trajectory calculations and measurements.
en.mathieu_source: NIST DLMF §§28.2 and 28.17 · Mathieu equation and stability
en.cooler_source: Herfurth et al., NIM A 469 (2001) 254–275 · RFQ cooler and buncher
en.collision_source: SIMION documentation · time-dependent fields and collision models

zh.title: RFQ 物理基础 · 从电压到束团宽度
zh.lead: 先明确电压定义，再逐步理解电场、离子运动与可观测量。以下计算属于理想模型或简化模型；各功能页分别标明适用条件。
zh.roles_title: 1 · 各类 RFQ 的物理作用是什么？
roles: 离子导引
交变横向聚焦使离子沿开放轴向传输。
给定入射束流条件下的孔径接受度和传输率。
冷却器
射频约束与缓冲气体碰撞共同减小相空间分布。
能散、发射度、冷却时间和存活比例。
质量过滤器
射频与差分直流电压选择一定的质荷比区间。
传输率随质荷比的变化、峰宽和质量分辨本领。
聚束器
轴向直流势阱储存离子，切换出口电势后释放束团。
束团电荷量、时间宽度、时间—能量关联和重复频率。
zh.roles_note: Mathieu 稳定点只说明理想电场中的横向稳定性；它不能直接给出冷却性能、离子传输率或质量分辨本领。
zh.field_title: 2 · 先定义电极电压，再计算 a 和 q
zh.field_text: 令 x 方向杆对相对于公共参考电位的电压为 +(U − V cos Ωt)，y 方向杆对为 −(U − V cos Ωt)。V 表示单根杆的射频峰值，Q = ze 为离子电荷，Ω = 2πfRF，r₀ 为内切圆半径。
zh.field_voltage: 对平衡驱动：单杆峰值 150 V = 单杆峰峰值 300 V = 两杆对之间差分峰值 300 V = 差分峰峰值 600 V。整体平台偏置是另一个物理量，不能代入这里的 V。
zh.field_derivation: 由 E = −∇Φ 和 m ẍ = QEx 出发，再代入 τ = Ωt/2。时间二阶导数中的 Ω²/4 因子给出下列系数。两个径向方向的 a、q 符号相反。
zh.field_stability: 两个径向方向都必须保持有界。a = 0 时，第一理想稳定区延伸至 |q| ≈ 0.908；q = 0 本身没有射频约束。高阶稳定带应使用完整的特征值计算。
zh.average_title: 3 · 区分慢速久期运动与射频微运动
zh.average_text: 在射频电场缓慢随空间变化、|q| 较小时，可对快速微运动取平均，得到赝势能 W。理想四极场的径向赝势能呈二次分布。下式的 D 为 r = r₀ 处的纯射频势阱深度；差分直流电压会改变两个方向的有效曲率。
zh.average_units: D 是能量：QVq/4 的单位为焦耳；当 V 以伏特给出时，D 的电子伏特数值为 zVq/4。接近稳定边界时，应使用 Mathieu 特征指数 β 和 fsec = βfRF/2，不能继续依赖小 q 近似。
zh.example_title: 计算示例 · 质量 100 u，单电荷离子
zh.example_inputs: U = 0 V；V = 150 V 单杆峰值；fRF = 0.700 MHz；r₀ = 10.0 mm。
zh.example_outputs: q = 0.2992656；D = 11.22246 eV；fsec ≈ 74.0644 kHz（小 q 近似）。这些是解析计算值，并非测量结果。
zh.sensitivity: 灵敏度：射频幅度加倍使 q 加倍；频率或孔径半径加倍使 q 变为原来的四分之一。U = 0、离子电荷固定时，fsec 正比于 V/(mfRF r₀²)。杆尺寸与有限电极长度的影响需要电场模型才能定量判断。
zh.gas_title: 4 · 从气压得到碰撞率，再讨论冷却
zh.gas_text: 利用局部气压与温度求气体数密度；碰撞频率还取决于截面和相对速度。气体页使用恒定速率的能量弛豫近似，因此不能把增加气压直接解释为已经验证的传输优化。
zh.gas_limits: 300 K 下，三维热平衡平均动能 3kBT/2 ≈ 0.03878 eV。射频加热、气流、与质量有关的碰撞运动学、电荷交换、空间电荷和孔径损失均可能改变真实结果。远离杆区的真空计读数未必等于局部冷却气压。
zh.bunch_title: 5 · 在漂移过程中传播时间—能量协方差
zh.bunch_text: 离子加速到平均动能 E 后，在长度 L 的无场区内飞行时间为 td = L√(m/2E)。在平均值附近线性展开：因为 g = ∂td/∂E 为负，较晚出发而能量较高的离子能够部分补偿时间差。因此输出时间方差必须包含协方差项。
zh.bunch_units: 单位必须一致：g 用 ns/eV 时，σt 用 ns、σE 用 eV。对高斯分布，FWHM = 2√(2 ln 2)σ ≈ 2.35482σ。本地事件表给出的高斯等效宽度，不等同于对非高斯峰进行拟合得到的宽度。
zh.bunch_limits: RFQ 出口束团宽度与 MR-TOF 探测器峰宽是不同的可观测量。切换电场、定时抖动和像差需要轨迹计算；后续离子光学可使带有关联的束团进一步聚焦或展宽。
zh.sources_title: 原始参考文献与模型边界
zh.sources_text: Lab 各页用于可重复的解析和数值探索。有限电极、随机碰撞冷却、引出电场以及经实验验证的传输率，需要进一步的电场与轨迹计算和测量。

zh.cooler_source: Herfurth 等，NIM A 469 (2001) 254–275 · RFQ 冷却器与聚束器
